note: Common Control Framework. A safeguard is the operated object: it carries one evidence requirement and one evaluation rule, and satisfies many framework requirements. Framework readiness is derived from safeguard posture, not the other way round. Every control_id under `satisfies` must exist in controls/catalog.json. A mapping is `reviewed` once a human has confirmed the requirements are genuinely the same obligation; `proposed` mappings were matched by title theme and are reported separately so unconfirmed work is never counted as attested coverage.

safeguards.title: Logical access and MFA
safeguards.objective: Logical access restrictions and MFA are assessed across SOC 2 CC6, ISO 27001 A.5.15, NIST CSF PR.AA, FedRAMP AC-2, CIS IAM, and HIPAA access management.
safeguards.evidence_requirement: Current identity, access review, privileged access, or authorization policy evidence exists and has no open high-risk failure.

safeguards.title: Access review and recertification
safeguards.objective: Periodic access reviews map to SOC 2 CC6.2, ISO 27001 A.8.2, and NIST CSF PR.AA-05.
safeguards.evidence_requirement: Current evidence demonstrates user registration and authorization are controlled with no open high-risk failure or stale proof.

safeguards.title: Encryption and data protection
safeguards.objective: Data encryption in transit and at rest spans SOC 2 CC6.7, ISO 27001 A.8.24, PCI DSS Req 7, HIPAA 164.312(e), and GDPR Art.32.
safeguards.evidence_requirement: Current evidence demonstrates data transmission and movement are protected with no open high-risk failure or stale proof.

safeguards.title: Monitoring and incident detection
safeguards.objective: Security monitoring and anomaly detection align across SOC 2 CC7.2, ISO 27001 A.8.16, PCI DSS Req 10, NIST CSF DE.AE, and FedRAMP AU-6.
safeguards.evidence_requirement: Current monitoring, runtime policy, audit, or alert evidence exists and unresolved high-risk monitoring failures are tracked.

safeguards.title: Audit logging and traceability
safeguards.objective: Immutable audit trails map to SOC 2 CC7.2, ISO 27001 A.8.15, PCI DSS Req 10, and FedRAMP AU-2.
safeguards.evidence_requirement: Current monitoring, runtime policy, audit, or alert evidence exists and unresolved high-risk monitoring failures are tracked.

safeguards.title: Change management
safeguards.objective: Controlled changes to production systems map to SOC 2 CC8.1, ISO 27001 A.8.32, NIST CSF PR.DS-01, and FedRAMP CM-3.
safeguards.evidence_requirement: Current evidence demonstrates changes to infrastructure and software are authorized and tested with no open high-risk failure or stale proof.

safeguards.title: Vulnerability management
safeguards.objective: Vulnerability identification and remediation spans SOC 2 CC7.1, ISO 27001 A.8.8, PCI DSS Req 11, NIST CSF ID.RA-01, and CIS AWS logging/monitoring.
safeguards.evidence_requirement: Current evidence demonstrates vulnerabilities are identified and remediated with no open high-risk failure or stale proof.

safeguards.title: Vendor and third-party risk
safeguards.objective: Third-party oversight maps to SOC 2 CC9.2, ISO 27001 A.5.19, GDPR Art.28, and NIST CSF GV.SC-05.
safeguards.evidence_requirement: Current evidence demonstrates vendor and partner relationships are monitored over time with no open high-risk failure or stale proof.

safeguards.title: Risk assessment
safeguards.objective: Formal risk assessment aligns SOC 2 CC3.2, ISO 27001 A.5.8, NIST CSF ID.RA-01, and HIPAA 164.308 risk analysis.
safeguards.evidence_requirement: Current evidence demonstrates risk to objectives is identified and analyzed with no open high-risk failure or stale proof.

safeguards.title: Backup and availability
safeguards.objective: Backup and recovery evidence maps to SOC 2 A1.2, ISO 27001 A.8.13, and NIST CSF PR.DS-01.
safeguards.evidence_requirement: Current evidence demonstrates environmental protections and backup processes support availability objectives with no open high-risk failure or stale proof.

safeguards.title: AI governance and model inventory
safeguards.objective: AI system governance spans NIST AI RMF GOVERN-1.1, ISO 42001 operational planning, and EU AI Act technical documentation.
safeguards.evidence_requirement: AI governance evidence identifies applicable legal and regulatory requirements for production AI systems.

safeguards.title: Privacy breach notification
safeguards.objective: Breach notification obligations align GDPR Art.33, SOC 2 privacy criteria P3.2, and HIPAA remediation planning.
safeguards.evidence_requirement: Incident-response runbook + breach-notification evidence exists; unresolved high-severity incidents have notification timers tracked.

safeguards.title: Governance and control environment
safeguards.objective: Board oversight, defined authority, accountability, and a maintained security policy are the control environment every audited framework opens with.
safeguards.evidence_requirement: CUI protection evidence supports NIST SP 800-171 Rev 2 requirement 3.12.4 (Develop, document, and periodically update system security plans that describe system boundaries, system environments of operation, how security requirements...) for CMMC Level 2 assessment.

safeguards.title: Security awareness and training
safeguards.objective: Workforce awareness and role-based training is a distinct obligation from access control, and is assessed separately.
safeguards.evidence_requirement: CUI protection evidence supports NIST SP 800-171 Rev 2 requirement 3.2.3 (Provide security awareness training on recognizing and reporting potential indicators of insider threat) for CMMC Level 2 assessment.

safeguards.title: Physical and environmental security
safeguards.objective: Physical access to systems and media is a separate boundary from logical access.
safeguards.evidence_requirement: CUI protection evidence supports NIST SP 800-171 Rev 2 requirement 3.10.1 (Limit physical access to organizational systems, equipment, and the respective operating environments to authorized individuals) for CMMC Level 2 assessment.

safeguards.title: Secure development
safeguards.objective: Secure development practices and separation of environments are assessed apart from change control.
safeguards.evidence_requirement: Evidence for PCI DSS v4 Req 6 exists within freshness SLA.

safeguards.title: Network security controls
safeguards.objective: Network segmentation and boundary protection is its own safeguard, distinct from identity.
safeguards.evidence_requirement: CUI protection evidence supports NIST SP 800-171 Rev 2 requirement 3.13.6 (Deny network communications traffic by default and allow network communications traffic by exception (i.e., deny all, permit by exception)) for CMMC Level 2 assessment.

safeguards.title: Privacy notices and data subject rights
safeguards.objective: Transparency and data subject rights are privacy obligations with no security-control equivalent.
safeguards.evidence_requirement: Evidence for GDPR Art.12 exists within freshness SLA.

safeguards.title: Data inventory and records of processing
safeguards.objective: Knowing what data is held and where is the precondition for every other data obligation.
safeguards.evidence_requirement: Processing-activity records evidence exists within freshness SLA and covers every in-scope system.

safeguards.title: Data retention and secure disposal
safeguards.objective: Retention limits and secure disposal are assessed separately from encryption.
safeguards.evidence_requirement: CUI protection evidence supports NIST SP 800-171 Rev 2 requirement 3.7.3 (Ensure equipment removed for off-site maintenance is sanitized of any CUI) for CMMC Level 2 assessment.

safeguards.title: Processing integrity
safeguards.objective: Inputs, processing, and outputs are complete, accurate, timely, and authorized — SOC 2's Processing Integrity criterion, which no confidentiality or availability safeguard covers.
safeguards.evidence_requirement: Current evidence demonstrates processing specifications define complete and accurate processing objectives with no open high-risk failure or stale proof.

safeguards.title: Separation of duties
safeguards.objective: Separate incompatible duties so one individual cannot complete a sensitive activity without independent participation.
safeguards.evidence_requirement: Current role, approval, and activity evidence demonstrates incompatible duties are assigned to separate individuals or roles with no open high-risk failure or stale proof.

safeguards.title: Controlled system maintenance
safeguards.objective: Authorize, schedule, record, and review maintenance on organizational systems and components.
safeguards.evidence_requirement: Current maintenance records identify the system or component, authorized personnel, work performed, completion time, and review outcome with no open high-risk failure or stale proof.
